bsp_dark_enchantment.message: Dark runes pulse beneath your feet, sending a warm, forbidden tingle through your body. Excitement +{value}.

bsp_portcullis.name: Crumbling Portcullis
bsp_portcullis.message: A rusty portcullis drops from the ceiling and clips you! You lose {value} HP!

bsp_moss_cushion.name: Moss Cushion
bsp_moss_cushion.message: You trip into a patch of thick, spongy moss. It's oddly comfortable and you feel a little better. +{value} HP.

bsp_stale_draft.name: Stale Draft Curse
bsp_stale_draft.message: An ancient curse seeps from the stones, sapping your vigor. STR -{value}.

bsp_ancient_dud.name: Rusted Mechanism
bsp_ancient_dud.message: An ancient mechanism clicks beneath your foot... but nothing happens. The trap has long since rusted out.

beats.text:
An old crib, painted that soft hospital pink, the bars worn smooth where small hands once gripped them. The mattress still holds a warm dent, as though someone only just climbed out.

There was a name on the headboard once. It has been sanded down to a pale ghost of itself.

You lean closer, and the smell of powder rises up, clean and sweet, and for one long blink the bars look less like a cage and more like a promise.

A padded changing table, set up and waiting. The mat is wiped clean. A tin of powder sits open beside a folded diaper - adult sized. Your size.

Someone keeps this station stocked and ready, for whoever comes next.

You realize you have been staring at it a moment too long, the way you might stare at a turned-down bed at the end of a very long day.

A toy chest, lid thrown back, spilling soft blocks across the floor. Someone was spelling something with them.

The letters trail off half finished: G - O - O - D - G - I - R.

The last block sits a little apart, as if the speller forgot what came next, or forgot why it mattered, and simply sat down to play instead.

A bottle warmer, plugged into nothing you can see, yet its little light glows a patient amber. Inside, a full bottle waits at exactly the right temperature.

There is a strip of tape on the side with a single letter inked on it. It is your initial. You did not write it.

You stand there far too long. The warm milk smell makes your jaw ache in a way you do not have a word for.

A rocking horse, mid-rock, creaking forward and back in the empty room.

Nobody is on it. Nobody just got off it - no dust disturbed, no warmth on the saddle. It simply rocks, slower and slower, the way it would if a child had ridden it for a very long time and then, gently, stopped being someone who needed to.

By the time you look away, it has almost gone still.

The entrance passage draws one long breath through the cracks around its stones. The draft is cellar-cold and clever enough to find every opening in your clothes.

For a moment the dungeon feels less like a ruin than a mouth deciding whether to swallow.

The portcullis drops behind you with a crash that punches dust from the ceiling. Nothing chased you through it. Nothing even touched the chain.

A hidden counter clicks once, satisfied. The gate rises again just slowly enough to make its point.

Behind a loose foundation stone you find an adventurer's pack, flattened by years but still buckled shut. Most of its contents have spoiled to dust. One blue vial survived.

A note tied around its neck reads: FOR THE WALK BACK. Whoever wrote it never made that walk. You might.

One shackle lifts from the wall. Then another. All along the cellblock, empty restraints pull their chains taut and turn toward the aisle as if presenting themselves for inspection.

They hang there waiting until you move. Then every chain drops at once.

The duty bell above the guard desk rings once. Its clapper is fused solid with rust, but the sound carries anyway.

Somewhere beyond the cells, boots scrape across stone. Whatever kept this watch has forgotten its name, but not its shift.

A scratched arrow on the lowest bunk points to a loose stone. Behind it is a careful stack of coins wrapped in cloth.

The prisoner who hid them counted on needing a start outside. Taking them feels less like theft than carrying that plan one room farther than they could.

A row of sealed sarcophagi exhales through seams that were not there a moment ago. The air rolls over you warm, sour, and thick with ancient herbs.

Your stomach clenches before you can cover your mouth. The lids settle. The crypt looks innocent again.

Something beneath the flagstones whispers the name you answered to when you were very small. Not loudly. It does not need to.

Dust shifts into the shape of tiny handprints around your boots, and your body remembers helplessness faster than your mind can object.

One votive candle still burns before a nameless grave. Its flame is small, steady, and perfectly ordinary.

You warm your hands over it. For a few breaths the dead ask nothing of you, and the living dungeon stays respectfully beyond the light.

A wooden rack finally gives up its argument with time. Blunted spears and rusted helmets crash across the floor around you.

None of the edges are sharp anymore. The weight does not care. You drag yourself clear while the last shield spins to a stop.

A sergeant's voice cracks through the empty armory: SHOULDERS BACK. FEET APART. HOLD.

Your muscles obey before you decide to. The inspection lasts until your arms tremble, followed by a disgusted sigh from someone dead long enough to have lost the right.

Under a rotted practice mat lies one dagger sealed in oiled cloth. Its balance is honest, its edge maintained, its grip sized for a real hand instead of a ceremonial statue.

In a room full of weapons made to impress the dead, you choose the one made to keep somebody alive.

A buried sluice gate grinds open. Black water races through the channel and over its lip, climbing past your boots before you can reach higher stone.

The flood drains as suddenly as it came. The cold clings, and every drip sounds like the dungeon counting.

The cistern surface domes upward in one enormous bubble. It bursts with a soft, wet pop and releases centuries of trapped sewer air.

The smell is physical. Your eyes water, your stomach twists, and retreat becomes less a decision than an instinct.

Above the stagnant basin, a hairline crack beads with clear water. You catch it in your palms. It is cold, clean, and tastes faintly of limestone.

There is not enough to carry, only enough to remind you that even down here the world is still making something fresh.

Loose chalk scratches across the floor without a hand to guide it. The line loops around your feet and closes.

For one breath you feel every rule ever written for your body pressing inward at once. Then the circle breaks, leaving the command behind where no boot can smudge it.

The stone altar answers your heartbeat with one of its own. A red pulse crosses the carved channels, reaches the edge, and passes into you through the soles of your feet.

The second beat comes from inside your body. The altar does not need a third.

Most of the ward has been chiseled away, but the missing pieces reveal how the surviving lines once fit together. You trace the logic without touching the stone.

The spell is broken. The lesson inside it is not, and that part belongs to you now.

The humming that followed you through the dungeon finally resolves into a lullaby. It comes through the walls in several soft voices, all singing half a beat apart.

Your thoughts slow. Your body listens more eagerly than you do, loosening under a comfort that was designed to become a need.

Cold hands that have no visible owners turn you toward the light. A measuring tape whispers around your waist. Somewhere beside your ear, an attendant clicks their tongue.

'Below regulation,' a voice murmurs. The correction is swift, practiced, and humiliatingly gentle. When the hands release you, the room smells faintly of powder.

A care cabinet unlatches with a clean pneumatic sigh. Its seal kept the dungeon out for years: folded supplies, wipes, and one absurdly thick piece of emergency protection remain spotless inside.

The label says FOR EXTENDED LOCKDOWN. You dislike what it assumes. You take the supplies anyway.

Sharp metal spikes spring up from hidden panels at your feet. You leap back but not fast enough — the tips catch you and draw blood. The sudden shock of pain makes your whole body clench, including muscles you wish hadn't.

A warm glow spreads from the floor beneath your feet. Soft golden runes spiral upward around your body, knitting your wounds closed and easing your aches. It feels like being tucked in — briefly, mercifully safe.

Something clicks beneath the floor and a wave of magical pressure hits your lower abdomen. Your bladder immediately clenches and fills, the urgency hitting you all at once like someone turned a faucet on inside you. You press your thighs together desperately.

A vent hisses open and thick, sweet-smelling gas billows into your face. Almost instantly your stomach starts gurgling and cramping — whatever that gas was, it went straight to your guts. The rumbling is loud enough that anyone nearby would definitely hear it.

A sickly purple light pulses from a cracked rune set into the wall. It doesn't hurt, but you feel your muscles slacken — your arms heavy, your grip weak. The magical fatigue settles over you like a damp, heavy blanket.

A glowing rune pulses beneath your feet and ethereal fingers of light brush across your skin. The sensation is overwhelmingly ticklish — you squirm and gasp as warm waves of involuntary excitement ripple through your body. By the time the rune fades, your composure is in tatters.

The floor beneath you hums with deep magical resonance. The vibration travels up through your legs and into your core, making your whole body flush with heat. Your cheeks burn and your thoughts scatter as the enchantment runs its course — leaving you flustered and very aware of your body.
A taut wire snaps up from the floor and bites into your stride before you can recover. You catch yourself, but only barely — your legs feel unsteady and drained.
Pressure hisses under your feet and a sticky burst splashes up your legs and waist. The glue hardens almost instantly — you're stuck in place, legs cemented to the floor.
You strain and pull, managing to loosen the grip slightly. The glue stretches but holds. Your muscles burn from the effort, but you refuse to give in.
You stand there, feeling the glue slowly soften against your body heat. It's humiliating being rooted in place like this — helpless, exposed, unable to do anything but wait.
With a final desperate wrench, you tear yourself free! Strips of glue still cling to your clothes, but you're moving again. Your determination kept your dignity mostly intact.

The glue finally dissolves enough for you to pull free. You've been standing here for what felt like an eternity — helpless, exposed, and increasingly aware of the pressure building in your bladder while you couldn't reach a bathroom.

The air in the corridor shifts, heavy and sweet like warm syrup, as the light blooms. It isn't a torch flicker or a torch shadow—it is a hard, sharp rectangle of luminescence that seems to be painted onto the air itself. It rises from the darkness, hovering just above the thick padding at your hips, casting a pale, rhythmic glow that syncs perfectly with the sickly pulse of the diaper magic.

The pulsing pattern is mesmerizing. A slow, rhythmic breathing light, expanding and contracting in time with your own heart, only to speed up just enough to throw your pulse off kilter. Your eyes lock onto it, wide and glassy, the warrior's focus trying desperately to calculate distance and threat. But the screen isn't measuring you; it is *feeding* you.

The pattern drags your focus for just a little too long before you wrench your gaze away, flushed and rattled. Your cheeks burn with a heat that has nothing to do with the dungeon's dampness. It is the heat of a mind being rewritten. The pacifier in your mouth hums louder, reacting to the screen's frequency, its rhythm matching the pulse of the light now burning against your retina.

You try to look away, to find the solid stone floor to ground yourself, but the light pulls you back. It’s not just light; it is a command. The goblins are watching the screen now too, their silhouettes still in the shadows, but their attention is fixed on the data floating before you. They aren't just watching; they are waiting for the final lock to click.

Your knees buckle, not from weakness, but from the sheer weight of the suggestion. The screen flashes a deeper green, and the thick padding between your thighs responds instantly. The cursed energy surges, hotter and heavier than before. The pressure in your bladder, already stretched to its limit, spikes into a blinding, white-hot urgency.

*The screen says you are full.*
*The screen says you are ready.*
*The screen says you must let go.*

It is a cruel trick of the light, a hypnotic suggestion that overrides the brain's "hold" command. You try to squeeze your thighs together, to clamp down against the shame, but the diaper has become your skeleton now. The plug inside you pulses in time with the screen, a physical reminder of your captivity.

Your breath hitches. The rattle in your hand goes limp, hanging by a single thread. The pacifier is a magnet now. *Suck.* The need is physical, a hunger that eclipses the hunger of the stomach. You are starving for the rhythm of the light.

With a whimper that vibrates through the heavy padding, you finally surrender your grip on the floor. You sink down, sitting back on the cold stone, your legs splaying wide over the thickening bulk of the diaper. The screen flashes one last time—a final pulse that hits your core like a lightning strike.

And then, the dam breaks.

It starts as a trickle, warm and shameful, then becomes a torrent that soaks through the fabric, soaking into the padding, into your legs, into the stone beneath you. It is a sound that fills the corridor—a wet, heavy rustle, the sound of a vessel finally overflowing. You don't pull the pacifier out. You don't reach for the tabs. You just watch the light pulse, your eyes hazy and glazed, as the heat spreads through the soaked layers.

You feel a strange, bubbling laugh rise in your throat, muffled by the rubber nipple. It is a laugh of relief. The shame is still there, burning behind your eyes, but it is drowned out by the warm, heavy comfort of the wetness against your skin. The screen dims, its work done.

You are no longer just a victim of the trap. You are part of the mechanism. The goblins emerge from the shadows, their cackling silent now, replaced by the heavy, rhythmic sound of your breathing and the soft, wet crinkle of your surrender. You close your eyes, letting the light fade behind your lashes, and for the first time, the warrior in your head is gone. There is only the hum of the pacifier, the heat of the diaper, and the silent, glowing promise that you will never be dry again.
A sigil flares beneath your boots and tears a glowing seam through the room. The air shivers — something answers the call and steps into the fight.
A sweet pink cloud blooms around you before you can back away. Your body responds with a sudden, unnerving loss of control that lingers after the smoke clears.
A pale rune ignites under your feet, then settles into a soft glow. The ache in your limbs eases and your breathing steadies as fresh energy returns.
A hinged arm whips down from above with brutal timing. The impact knocks the breath out of you and leaves a sharp, lingering sting.

Wire hooks snap around your torso and hoist you into a padded bouncer seat suspended from the ceiling. Your feet dangle uselessly above the floor. The seat bounces you gently, rhythmically, and every bounce sends a warm tingle through your body.
You grab at the hooks and twist, but the bouncing makes it hard to get a grip. Each failed attempt leaves you more flushed and out of breath.
The bouncing continues. Your cheeks burn as you sit there, legs dangling, gently bobbing up and down like an oversized toddler. The seat is distressingly comfortable.

actions.label: Wait for the spring to wind down...

beats.text: You finally wrench the last hook free and tumble out of the bouncer seat, landing roughly on the floor. Undignified, but free. You dust yourself off with what pride you have left.

The spring mechanism finally winds down and the seat lowers enough for your feet to touch the floor. You slide out, face burning. The whole time your bladder was being jostled mercilessly — and you're not sure how much longer you can hold it.

The floor panel drops away beneath your feet and a geyser of warm, soapy fluid erupts upward, drenching you from waist to ankles. Your clothes cling uncomfortably, and the warm liquid against your skin makes your bladder clench in protest.

FLASH! A hidden camera fires from behind a panel, capturing you in your current state — flushed, disheveled, and very obviously not in control of your situation. The photo ejects from a slot in the wall with a mechanical whirr. Someone, somewhere, is going to see this.

A heavy metal cage crashes down from above, trapping you inside. The bars are close together — you can barely move your arms. The impact rattled your bones, and now you're stuck in this cramped space.

actions.label: Rattle the bars and try to force your way out!
Sit down and wait to be released...

beats.text: The bars bend slightly under your desperate shoving. The mechanism groans. You're making progress, but the cage is sturdy.
You sit on the cold floor of the cage, knees drawn up, trying to ignore the pressure building in your bladder. Every minute trapped here makes it harder.
With a final heave, the cage door buckles open and you stumble out. Your hands are raw from the bars, but your determination is intact.
The cage finally retracts into the ceiling with a mechanical grind. You're free, but the time spent trapped and helpless has left you shaken and increasingly desperate for a bathroom.

Glittering dust erupts from hidden vents in a shimmering cloud. It coats your skin like warm sugar, tingling wherever it touches. Your body flushes with heat and your thoughts scatter momentarily. By the time you shake it off, the damage is done — your composure is thoroughly rattled.

A thin dart fires from a concealed slot in the wall and pricks your arm before you can react. The puncture stings, but the real worry is the warm numbness spreading from the injection site. Whatever was in that dart, your bladder is going to feel it for the next few turns.

Hidden sprinkler heads activate from every direction at once, drenching you in warm water. Your clothes are soaked through in seconds, clinging to your body and making every movement audible. The warm liquid running down your legs feels uncomfortably familiar.
Living vines erupt from cracks in the floor and coil around your ankles, then your waist, then your arms. They pulse faintly with bioluminescent light as they tighten. You're completely immobilized.

actions.label: Hold still and let them loosen...

beats.text: You rip at the vines with all your strength. Some snap, but new tendrils immediately replace them, wrapping tighter against your skin. You can feel them probing for a better grip.
You hold perfectly still. The vines seem to relax fractionally when you stop resisting, but they don't release. Held here, suspended, you're painfully aware of how full your bladder has become.
With a final violent wrench, the vines shred apart and you stumble free. Green sap covers your arms and legs, but you're out. The vines retreat back into the floor, spent.
The vines eventually lose interest and slither back underground. You're free — but the time spent held immobile and helpless has left you flushed, shaking, and desperate.

You stumble onto a painted rocking horse that immediately starts moving on its own, rocking faster and faster. The saddle's enchanted surface pulses with warm magic that makes your whole body flush. By the time it finally stops and dumps you onto the floor, you're thoroughly rattled.

A ghostly mirror materializes in front of you, showing your reflection — except it's not showing you as you are now. It's showing you in a much more vulnerable state: smaller, less composed, wearing something far more embarrassing. You know it's just a projection, but the image burns into your memory anyway.

Clammy, damp hands reach out from hidden slots in the walls and grab hold of your wrists and ankles. They're cold, rubbery, and distressingly strong. You can feel their grip tightening as you process what just happened.

actions.label: Wait for them to lose grip...

beats.text: You twist and pull against the groping hands. One releases, but another immediately takes its place from a different slot.
The hands hold you in place, cold fingers wrapped around your wrists and ankles. One of them starts gently patting your head. That's somehow worse than the restraint.
You rip free from the last hand with a desperate twist. They retract into the wall slots with a wet slurp. You shudder, but at least you got out on your own terms.

The hands eventually release you, each one giving you a little pat before sliding back into the wall. You're free — and deeply unsettled. Also, your bladder did NOT appreciate being held still that long.

A sarcophagus-like structure slams shut around you with a metallic clang. The interior is padded — it's not actually meant to impale you, but the confinement is total. You can barely move your arms. The darkness inside is absolute.

actions.label: Push against the door with everything you have!
Conserve energy and wait for it to open...

beats.text: You throw your shoulder against the door. It shifts slightly — there's a mechanism in there somewhere. The padding squishes around you as you strain, making embarrassing squeaking sounds.
Time passes in the dark. You can hear your own breathing, your own heartbeat. The padding is warm. It's almost... comfortable. Your bladder throbs, and there's nothing you can do about it in here.
The mechanism gives with a satisfying crunch and the door swings open. You tumble out into the light, gasping. Bruised but unbroken — you escaped on your own strength.

The iron maiden opens on a timer with a hiss of hydraulics. You stumble out, blinking, disoriented, and very aware that you've been trapped in total darkness for far too long. Your muscles ache and your bladder is screaming.

Mechanical arms seize you and deposit you onto a narrow wooden horse. The pointed edge presses uncomfortably upward as your full weight settles, and your feet can't quite reach the ground. Every tiny shift sends intense waves through your body.

actions.label: Sit still until the mechanism lowers...

beats.text: You shift your weight, trying to dismount. The horse sways but the clamps on the base hold firm. Each movement just intensifies the sensation, making it harder to think straight.
You try to hold perfectly still, but the horse's enchantment makes your body respond to every slight vibration. Time crawls by. Your face is burning and your bladder won't stop complaining.
You finally manage to topple the horse sideways and roll free. Your legs are shaking and everything below your waist is tingling, but you escaped through sheer willpower.

The mechanism finally lowers and the clamps release. You slide off the horse and crumple to the floor, overwhelmed. The experience has left you shaky, flushed, and with a bladder that's been tormented for far too long.

A thin beam of pink light sweeps across the corridor and catches you full in the chest. Your vision swims and your muscles turn to jelly. By the time it passes, you feel noticeably weaker — and your body's sense of 'holding things in' has gotten significantly fuzzier.

Click. Whirr. A mechanical arm extends from the wall, rotates once, and retracts with a sad little squeak. Nothing happens. You stare at the spot where the trap was, waiting for the other shoe to drop. Still nothing. You feel oddly cheated.

A dart hisses from a slot in the ancient stonework and catches your arm. The tip burns — not lethally, but enough to make you flinch and stumble. A thin trickle of blood winds down to your wrist as the venom makes your skin tingle.

The flagstones give way and you tumble into a shallow pit lined with rusted spikes. The fall knocks the breath out of you and the spikes tear at your clothes and skin. You claw your way out, battered and shaking.

Warm water bubbles up through cracked flagstones, pooling around your feet in a soft golden glow. The spring water tingles against your skin and your wounds begin to close. It's soothing — almost too soothing for a place like this.

You step on a stone that shifts with a grinding click. Cold water jets from hidden nozzles in the ceiling and drenches you head to toe. The chill goes straight to your core — and straight to your bladder. You squeeze your legs together, gasping.

A rusted grate beneath your feet erupts with a belch of hot sewer gas. The stench hits your stomach like a fist — you double over as your guts cramp and churn. The rumbling doesn't stop even after the air clears.

Dark runes pulse in the grooves between stone tiles, painting your skin in crimson light. A forbidden warmth blooms in your chest and works its way downward. You clutch the wall for support, flushed and desperately unsteady.

A portcullis drops from its housing in a shower of rust and stone chips. The iron grate clips your shoulder on the way down and the impact sends you stumbling sideways. At least it's too rusted to trap you underneath.

You trip over an uneven flagstone and land face-first in a thick patch of luminescent moss. It's absurdly soft — like falling into a warm pillow. The moss's gentle glow seeps through your clothes and a tingle mends your scrapes.

A stale draft rolls through the corridor, carrying something ancient and spiteful with it. The curse is subtle — you barely feel it settle over you — but your arms grow heavy and your step falters. Strength drains away like water.

A mechanism clicks beneath the flagstone, followed by a grinding noise, a sad wheeze, and then silence. Whatever this trap was supposed to do, it stopped working approximately three centuries ago. You almost feel bad for it.

Mira studies your face for half a second, not to decide whether the request is reasonable but to decide how much pretending you need from her. Apparently the answer is none. She flips the cart's sign to CLOSED FOR INVENTORY and drops the canvas sidewalls one after another until the market becomes a warm blur of footsteps and voices.

"Service is service," she says, setting the brake on both wheels. "You asked plainly. I answer plainly. No price, no favor owed, and no story for the next customer."

A padded crate becomes a changing bench. A clean cloth covers it. Mira checks the canvas seams from inside, then hangs her heavy merchant's coat over the one gap that might admit a curious eye. Only after the little space is properly private does she unlock the drawer beneath her best stock.

The drawer contains wipes, powder, disposal sacks, and spare padding arranged with the same ruthless organization as potions and travel rations. Mira lines up exactly what she needs and puts everything else away before the first package is opened.

She treats your old protection like damaged merchandise that deserves an honest inspection, never like evidence against you. If a curse holds it, she finds the hidden seam in the enchantment and worries it loose with the flat of a coin marked against hexes. If it is only used and stubborn, warm cloth and patience do the work. Either way, she keeps the canvas conversation deliberately ordinary—road conditions, unreasonable wholesalers, which town cheats worst on lamp oil—until the old padding finally comes free.

It is folded inward, bagged twice, and dropped into a metal return bin. "Some stock should never re-enter circulation," Mira says, fastening the lid.

From a separate drawer she chooses the {diaper}, checks the packaging date, and runs a thumb along every fastening before opening it. Nothing about the care is bargain-bin. The wipes are warm. The powder is used sparingly. When she notices a sore place, her efficient hands become gentler without her voice changing at all.

Mira shakes out the gathers, centers the back panel, and brings the fresh padding up in measured stages. The first tape is set lightly so it can still be corrected; the opposite tape balances it; only then does she seal them fully. You shift once, and she redoes a corner rather than insist it is good enough.

"A merchant who says fit does not matter is planning to be gone before you complain," she says. A final finger checks each leg seal. The {diaper} sits clean, even, and secure beneath her practiced appraisal.

Mira helps you down from the crate and waits while you take several steps inside the curtained cart. She watches the waistband instead of your expression, looking for any shift that means a tape needs adjusting. Satisfied, she smooths your outer clothes back into place and returns every supply to its exact drawer.

The cart changes from private room to shop again in less than a minute. Coat removed, canvas raised, brake released, sign turned from CLOSED FOR INVENTORY to OPEN. The market has barely noticed the interruption.

"There," she says, already straightening a row of bottles. "Clean protection, correct fit, no interest charged. If you need help again, ask before discomfort turns into an emergency. Emergencies are terrible for negotiating leverage."

It is a joke, but a careful one. The fresh {diaper} moves comfortably when you step back toward the road, and Mira does not look up to see whether you are grateful.

Nanny Mabel's answer is a brisk, satisfied nod that suggests asking was the only sensible part of the problem. From somewhere inside her apron comes a folding screen, followed by a waterproof changing cloth, a packet of wipes, powder, two disposal sacks, and a small enamel basin. The apron does not appear large enough to contain even the screen. Mabel notices you noticing and refuses to dignify the geometry with an explanation.

"Good," she says, placing the screen where it blocks both the corridor and the nearest reflective surface. "Nanny Rule Number Eight: asking for help is a grown-up decision. Waiting until one is miserable merely gives the laundry more authority than it deserves."

She checks that you are ready, warms the cloths, and makes the temporary little room feel organized before asking you to sit.

Mabel approaches the old padding with the calm of someone who has met every possible fastening and considered none of them impressive. She warns before adjusting your clothes, keeps a cover across you whenever her hands are not actively working, and talks through the change in a stream of practical rules about skin, comfort, and not mistaking shame for self-sufficiency.

If the diaper is cursed, it locks down in protest. Mabel presses a glowing charm against the waistband and tells the enchantment, in the same tone she might use on a child refusing bedtime, that it has had quite enough attention. The binding snaps with a sulky spark. If there is no curse, her hands are simply quick and gentle.

The old padding is folded inward and sealed away. Warm wipes replace chill and discomfort. Mabel checks carefully for redness, never rushing because the embarrassing part seems finished.

The {diaper} opens across the changing cloth with a soft papery sound. Mabel fluffs the standing gathers, tests the tapes, and adds exactly enough powder to keep the new fit comfortable without filling the air. Every step has the ease of long practice, but none is done without telling you first.

She lifts the back panel into place, guides the front up smoothly, and pauses so you can settle before fastening anything. The lower tapes land first, angled to protect without pinching. The upper pair follow beneath her thumbs, even enough that the printed front sits perfectly centered. Mabel checks each leg opening, slides two fingers beneath the waistband, and asks you to breathe deeply.

One tape is moved by the width of a fingernail. Only then does she pronounce the fit correct. The fresh {diaper} feels secure rather than restrictive, its clean bulk unmistakable and carefully chosen.

Mabel helps you stand and keeps one hand ready until she is certain your balance has returned. Your clothes are straightened layer by layer. She brushes away a trace of powder, smooths the waistband, and gives the padded front one final professional pat—not teasing, not possessive, simply the punctuation at the end of completed care.

"There. Clean, secure, and properly looked after," she says. The supplies disappear into her apron in reverse order, including the impossible screen. "Remember the rule. Needing protection is a fact. Asking for a change is a decision. Only one of those tells Nanny whether you are being responsible."

She opens the way back to the corridor and waits while you take a few test steps. The {diaper} stays comfortably in place. Mabel nods once, satisfied, and sends you onward with the expression of someone who expects you to ask sooner next time.

Basil.label: Collect the letter for Nell
Basil.text: Basil hands you the letter for Nell in the Observation sector.

Nurse Rachel.label: Accept the Adult-Thought Vaccine
Nurse Rachel.text: Nurse Rachel administers the injection. Its effects will last thirty turns.

deep_room.description: Sergeant Brom wants proof you can reach the far Dungeon stairs to Arcadia and return.
deep_room.offer_line: Find the far stairs to Arcadia and come back alive.

temporary_continence_potion.name: Temporary Continence Potion
temporary_continence_potion.desc: Sets continence to 100% for 250 turns. Replaces any temporary incontinence potion; another dose refreshes the duration.

permanent_continence_potion.name: Permanent Continence Potion
permanent_continence_potion.desc: Increases continence by 20 percentage points permanently, within the 0–100% range.

temporary_incontinence_potion.name: Temporary Incontinence Potion
temporary_incontinence_potion.desc: Sets incontinence to 100% (0% continence) for 250 turns. Replaces any temporary continence potion; another dose refreshes the duration.

permanent_incontinence_potion.name: Permanent Incontinence Potion
permanent_incontinence_potion.desc: Increases incontinence by 20 percentage points permanently, within the 0–100% range.

rattle_1.name: Baby Rattle
rattle_1.desc: A rattle that deals {atk} damage per swing.

cursed_teddy.name: Cursed Teddy Bear
cursed_teddy.desc: A possessed teddy bear clamped onto your arm. It giggles when you swing it and cries when you try to put it down. A friendly face might be able to pry it off. It shines when you need to be brave.

popup_lines: {item} shines, and for a moment {name} is nobody's baby at all.
A clean bright courage runs out of {item} and into {name}'s chest.
magical_effects.lock_text: You struggle against {item}...

goblin_rattle.name: Goblin Baby Rattle
goblin_rattle.desc: An oversized rattle painted with goblins. Every swing makes humiliating rattling noises. Deals 4 damage.

wooden_sword.name: Wooden Sword
wooden_sword.desc: A sturdy practice sword. Deals 8 damage per swing.

pacifier.name: Blessed Pacifier
pacifier.desc: A soothing pacifier. Restores +1 HP at the start of each turn while equipped.

cursed_paci.name: Cursed Goblin Pacifier
cursed_paci.desc: A dark, pulsing pacifier jammed in by goblins. It won't come out on its own. Adds +1 Wet and +1 Tum every turn. A friendly face might be able to remove it. Sometimes it decides you have had enough of walking about.

magical_effects.lock_text: {item} swells against {name}'s tongue and every muscle goes soft and useless.

goblin_plug.name: Goblin Rubber Plug
goblin_plug.desc: A crude rubber plug shoved in by goblins. It won't budge on its own. Keeps things in (+10 Tum Resist) but loosens the front (-1 Wet Resist).

bottle.name: Milk Bottle
bottle.desc: A warm bottle of milk. Restores 15 HP.

skirtP1.name: Pleated Schoolgirl Skirt
skirtP1.desc: A pleated skirt. May or may not cover your panties

diaper.name: Fluffy Diaper
diaper.desc: Extra padding. Protects against accidents. Hard to move in. ATK -1, DEX -2.

cursed_pottypants_diaper.name: Cursed PottyPants Diaper
cursed_pottypants_diaper.desc: A thick, magically cursed diaper fastened by goblins. It pulses with dark energy, filling itself by force. Cannot be removed by normal means. ATK -2, DEF -1, DEX -3. The leg elastic grips like it has fingers.

magical_effects.lock_text: {item} clamps around {name}'s hips and thighs and simply will not let her walk.

blessed_pottypants_diaper.name: Blessed PottyPants Diaper
blessed_pottypants_diaper.desc: A thick, gently enchanted diaper that hums with soft light. It does not force accidents, but its magic slowly... reshapes you. ATK -2, DEF -1, DEX -3. It quietly takes care of things for you.

popup_lines: {item} goes cool and dry against {name}, as if it simply decided to forgive her.
Whatever {name} just did to {item}, it takes it away without comment.
magical_effects.lock_text: You struggle against {item}...

diaper_hugger_diaper.name: Diaper-Hugger's Embrace
diaper_hugger_diaper.desc: A thick enchanted diaper that hugged itself snug around you and will NOT let go until it is completely full. It hums with the same soft, reshaping magic as a blessed diaper. Capacity 20. ATK -2, DEF -1, DEX -3.

bunny_onesie.name: Bunny Onesie
bunny_onesie.desc: A fuzzy onesie with floppy bunny ears. Makes you want to hop and giggle!

rainbow_booties.name: Rainbow Booties
rainbow_booties.desc: Soft booties in every color! You can't help but wiggle your toes.

pacifier_necklace.name: Pacifier Necklace
pacifier_necklace.desc: A necklace with a big, silly pacifier. Makes you sound extra babyish!

giggle_mittens.name: Giggle Mittens
giggle_mittens.desc: Fluffy mittens that make you giggle when you swing them!

cursed_lollipop.name: Cursed Lollipop
cursed_lollipop.desc: A magical lollipop that makes you feel extra silly and babyish! Increases shame.

tickle_feather.name: Tickle Feather
tickle_feather.desc: A silly feather that makes you giggle uncontrollably! Using it increases shame.

cotton_panties.name: Cotton Panties
cotton_panties.desc: Plain cotton underwear. Comfortable and practical.

lace_panties.name: Lace Panties
lace_panties.desc: Delicate lace underwear. Very pretty, very grown-up.

frilly_panties.name: Frilly Panties
frilly_panties.desc: Adorably frilly with little bows on the waistband. At least they're comfy.

training_pants.name: Training Pants
training_pants.desc: Thick padded cotton pants for... practice. Slightly restricts movement. DEX -1.

pull_up.name: Pull-Up
pull_up.desc: A padded pull-up in a cheerful cartoon print. Makes a crinkling sound when you walk. DEX -1.

printed_diaper.name: Printed Diaper
printed_diaper.desc: A thick diaper printed with colorful stars. Very obvious. Very babyish. ATK -1, DEX -2.

nighttime_diaper.name: Nighttime Diaper
nighttime_diaper.desc: An extra-thick overnight diaper. Enormous. Waddle-inducing. ATK -1, DEF -1, DEX -2.

plastic_panties.name: Crinkly Diaper Cover
plastic_panties.desc: Crinkly plastic cover worn over a diaper. Everyone within earshot will know it's there. DEX -1.

iron_dagger.name: Iron Dagger
iron_dagger.desc: A short, sharp blade. Quick and deadly. Deals 10 damage.

short_sword.name: Short Sword
short_sword.desc: A reliable one-handed sword. Deals 12 damage.

rolling_pin.name: Rolling Pin
rolling_pin.desc: Borrowed from a kitchen. Heavier than it looks. Deals 7 damage.

toy_wand.name: Toy Magic Wand
toy_wand.desc: A glittery plastic wand with a star on top. Surprisingly effective. Deals 5 damage.

plush_hammer.name: Plush Hammer
plush_hammer.desc: A giant stuffed mallet. Squeaks on impact. Deals 4 damage.

hair_bow.name: Big Hair Bow
hair_bow.desc: An enormous ribbon bow. Impossible to ignore.

princess_tiara.name: Princess Tiara
princess_tiara.desc: A sparkly tiara fit for a little princess. +1 CHA, probably.

witch_hat.name: Witch Hat
witch_hat.desc: A tall pointed hat. Marginally imposing. +1 DEF.

knight_helm.name: Knight's Helmet
knight_helm.desc: A solid iron helmet. Heavy but protective. +3 DEF.

frilly_dress.name: Frilly Baby Dress
frilly_dress.desc: A poofy dress with layers of lace and ruffles. Adorable and a little embarrassing. +1 DEF.

leather_vest.name: Leather Vest
leather_vest.desc: Tough stitched leather. No nonsense protection. +3 DEF.

school_uniform_top.name: School Uniform Blouse
school_uniform_top.desc: A crisp white blouse with a Peter Pan collar. Very proper. +1 DEF.

knit_sweater.name: Knit Sweater
knit_sweater.desc: A soft woolly sweater with a duck pattern on the front. Cozy. +1 DEF.

bloomers.name: Puffy Bloomers
bloomers.desc: Billowy shorts gathered at the knee. Cute, but bulk over 2 will peek out.

overalls.name: Geometry Top
overalls.desc: Denim shortalls with big bib pockets. Hides most things. +1 DEF. Bulk 2+ may show.

blue_jeans.name: Blue Jeans
blue_jeans.desc: Classic denim. Good coverage, grown-up look. +1 DEF. Bulk 1+ may show.

short_shorts.name: Short Shorts
short_shorts.desc: Barely there. Everything is visible. Does not conceal panties.

knee_socks.name: Striped Knee Socks
knee_socks.desc: Tall socks with cheerful stripes. Very schoolgirl.

ruffle_socks.name: Ruffle Ankle Socks
ruffle_socks.desc: Tiny frilly socks with a lace trim. Unmistakably babyish.

ankle_socks.name: Ankle Socks
ankle_socks.desc: Plain white socks. Nothing to see here.

mary_janes.name: Mary Jane Shoes
mary_janes.desc: Shiny patent leather with a single strap buckle. Very dainty.

boots.name: Sturdy Boots
boots.desc: Heavy-duty boots that mean business. +2 DEF.

mossy_amulet.name: Mossy Amulet
mossy_amulet.desc: A crumbling stone pendant covered in luminous moss. Hums with old magic. +2 DEF.

willow_switch.name: Willow Switch
willow_switch.desc: A thin, whippy branch torn from a weeping willow. Stings terribly. Deals 14 damage.

toadstool_cap.name: Toadstool Cap
toadstool_cap.desc: A large red-and-white mushroom cap worn as a hat. Slightly poisonous aura. +2 DEF.

enchanted_blankie.name: Enchanted Blankie
enchanted_blankie.desc: A tattered security blanket that glows faintly in darkness. Warm and comforting. +3 DEF, but very babyish.

spider_silk_panties.name: Spider Silk Panties
spider_silk_panties.desc: Woven from enchanted spider silk. Nearly invisible but surprisingly sturdy. +1 DEF.

fairy_dust_bottle.name: Fairy Dust Bottle
fairy_dust_bottle.desc: A tiny bottle of glittering fairy dust. Restores 25 HP and fully replenishes MP. Tastes like regret and sparkles.

cursed_paci_forest.name: Haunted Pacifier
cursed_paci_forest.desc: A ghostly pacifier that materialised from the forest fog. Restores +3 HP per turn but increases wet by 2 per step. Cannot be removed normally.

bramble_bow.name: Bramble Bow
bramble_bow.desc: A hair bow woven from thorny vines and tiny forest flowers. Pretty but prickly. +1 DEF.

cobweb_diaper.name: Cobweb Diaper
cobweb_diaper.desc: A thick diaper woven from enchanted cobwebs. Soft as clouds, embarrassing as everything. ATK -1, DEX -2.

moonlit_rattle.name: Moonlit Rattle
moonlit_rattle.desc: A silver rattle that glows under moonlight. Its chime stuns forest creatures. Deals 11 damage.

wet_moss_boots.name: Wet Moss Boots
wet_moss_boots.desc: Boots grown from living moss. Always slightly damp. +2 DEF but -1 Wet Resist.

owl_feather_cap.name: Owl Feather Cap
owl_feather_cap.desc: A cap decorated with enchanted owl feathers. You feel wiser and slightly judgmental. +2 DEF.

ghostly_onesie.name: Ghostly Onesie
ghostly_onesie.desc: A translucent onesie that phases in and out of visibility. Spooky AND embarrassing. +3 DEF.

thorn_vine_skirt.name: Thorn Vine Skirt
thorn_vine_skirt.desc: A skirt woven from living thorny vines. It conceals what's underneath but pricks anyone who gets too close. +1 DEF.

mushroom_plug.name: Enchanted Mushroom Plug
mushroom_plug.desc: A smooth, magically-grown mushroom cork. Firm but gentle. +8 Tum Resist, -2 Wet Resist.

baby_wipes.name: Baby Wipes
baby_wipes.desc: A soothing pack of baby wipes. Cleans you up and settles the lingering shame - but your body grows a little more dependent on them.

baby_food.name: Baby Food
baby_food.desc: Mushy, sweet purée in a little jar. Restores some health, but sits extremely heavy in your tummy for a long time.

daily_shame_pass.name: Daily Shame Pass
daily_shame_pass.desc: A laminated card from a LittleBig City kiosk. Good for one humiliation-free changing session per day, if you can find the right attendant.

comped_padding.name: Comped Padding Voucher
comped_padding.desc: Your complimentary first-visit changing voucher from the Grand Diaper Kiosk. The clerk insisted it's free — but slipped a glittery sticker on it anyway.

padded_purse.name: Padded Purse
padded_purse.desc: A small embroidered purse from the city Lost & Found. The lining is suspiciously absorbent, and there are a few spare baby-print folded squares tucked inside.

adult_food.name: Adult Food
adult_food.desc: A proper grown-up meal. Restores more health than baby food, and the tummy effects are milder and shorter-lived.

sippy_juice.name: Sippy Cup of Juice
sippy_juice.desc: A bright, overfull sippy cup of fruit juice. Restores some health, but it goes right through you.

water_bottle.name: Water Bottle
water_bottle.desc: A plain plastic water bottle. Restores some health. All that water has somewhere to go.

mystery_potion.name: Red Mystery Potion
mystery_potion.desc: A crimson bottle with a warm, metallic shimmer. It mends every bruise right away and leaves a fierce warmth in your chest.

mystery_potion_2.name: Pink Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_2.desc: A rosy little bottle that smells like candy and flowers. It patches you up halfway with a soft, sugary warmth.

mystery_potion_3.name: Black Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_3.desc: An inky bottle that swallows the light around it. The taste is dense and bitter, but somewhere underneath it your body feels a little steadier.

mystery_potion_4.name: Clear Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_4.desc: A nearly invisible draught that tastes like cold rain. Your body steadies and the last grime of embarrassment washes clean away.

mystery_potion_5.name: Blue Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_5.desc: A bright cerulean bottle that cools your throat on the way down. It heals you completely and leaves behind a deep, quiet chill.

mystery_potion_6.name: Green Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_6.desc: A fizzy green tonic that puts spring back in your legs. You feel lighter, quicker, and ready to keep moving.

mystery_potion_7.name: Purple Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_7.desc: A plum-colored cordial that hums with arcane static. Your magic surges back at once with a sharp little thrill.

mystery_potion_8.name: Orange Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_8.desc: A sunny orange bottle with a sharp citrus bite. It patches you up halfway and leaves a bright, restless energy behind.

mystery_potion_9.name: White Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_9.desc: A pearly white bottle that tastes strangely clean. It calms your nerves immediately and leaves you feeling fresh and composed.

mystery_potion_10.name: Teal Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_10.desc: A sea-glass bottle with a soothing mineral taste. It steadies your body right away with a cool, grounding calm.

mystery_potion_11.name: Gold Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_11.desc: A sparkling golden bottle that feels almost luxurious. It gives your body a quick lift and a pleasant little burst of vitality.

mystery_potion_12.name: Silver Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_12.desc: A silvery draught that crackles over your tongue like moonlight. It restores a little magic and clears your head in one bright flash.

mystery_potion_13.name: Indigo Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_13.desc: A dark blue bottle with a sleepy herbal scent. It goes down gently and leaves a dreamy herbal calm lingering in your body.

mystery_potion_14.name: Rose Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_14.desc: A soft rose bottle with a powdery floral taste. It seems quiet at first, but a soft clean feeling lingers underneath it.

stamina_potion.name: Stamina Potion
stamina_potion.desc: A fizzing sky-blue vial. Your legs feel solid the moment you pop the cork. Restores your stamina fully.

ghost_bloomers.name: Ghost Bloomers
ghost_bloomers.desc: Semi-transparent bloomers woven from ectoplasm. They shimmer and phase in and out of sight - unfortunately, so does whatever's underneath.

ghost_milk.name: Ghost Milk
ghost_milk.desc: A bottle of shimmering spectral milk. It's ice-cold and slightly see-through. Restores 20 HP.

ghostweave_dress.name: Ghostweave Dress
ghostweave_dress.desc: An ethereal baby dress stitched from ghost silk. The ruffles float as if underwater. Embarrassingly adorable. +3 DEF.

ghostly_rattle.name: Ghostly Rattle
ghostly_rattle.desc: A phantom rattle that chills the air with every swing. Its eerie chime echoes through the forest. Deals 13 damage.

spectral_sword.name: Spectral Sword
spectral_sword.desc: A translucent blade of solidified moonlight. Rare and devastatingly sharp. Deals 18 damage.

thorn_crown.name: Thorn Crown
thorn_crown.desc: A circlet of living thorny brambles. It pricks your forehead but radiates protective magic. +2 DEF.

thorned_wand.name: Thorned Wand
thorned_wand.desc: A gnarled wand wrapped in thorny vines. Blooms with tiny flowers when it strikes. Deals 12 damage.

thorn_pacifier.name: Thorn Pacifier
thorn_pacifier.desc: A pacifier carved from enchanted thornwood. Surprisingly soothing - the thorns retract when sucked. +2 HP per turn, but -1 Wet Resist.

vine_plug.name: Vine Plug
vine_plug.desc: A smooth plug grown from enchanted vine roots. It curls snugly into place. +7 Tum Resist, -1 Wet Resist.

vine_skirt.name: Vine Skirt
vine_skirt.desc: A skirt woven from living green vines. Excellent coverage - the dense foliage hides almost anything. +1 DEF.

root_boots.name: Root Boots
root_boots.desc: Boots grown from tangled tree roots. They grip the forest floor and feel alive. +2 DEF.

bark_armor.name: Bark Armor
bark_armor.desc: Plates of enchanted bark lashed together with living vines. Heavy but incredibly protective. +4 DEF.

mossy_socks.name: Mossy Socks
mossy_socks.desc: Socks woven from enchanted forest moss. Soft, springy, and faintly glowing.

cobweb_panties.name: Cobweb Panties
cobweb_panties.desc: Gossamer-thin undies woven from enchanted spider silk. Nearly invisible but surprisingly sturdy. +1 DEF.

cursed_swamp_diaper.name: Cursed Swamp Diaper
cursed_swamp_diaper.desc: A foul, mud-soaked diaper dredged from the swamp depths. Dark magic keeps it fastened. Constantly damp. ATK -2, DEX -3. Cannot be removed normally. A cold trickle of magic runs through the padding.

magical_effects.log_text: {item} leaks its hex through you: Wet +6, Shame -10.
magical_effects.lock_text: You struggle against {item}...

enchanted_diaper.name: Enchanted Diaper
enchanted_diaper.desc: A softly glowing diaper infused with protective magic. Embarrassing, but it heals you over time. +1 HP per turn, +1 DEF. DEX -1.

mushroom_stew.name: Mushroom Stew
mushroom_stew.desc: A hearty stew brewed from enchanted forest fungi. Warm, filling, and restorative. Restores 20 HP.

foam_mallet.name: Foam Mallet
foam_mallet.desc: A gigantic padded foam mallet shaped like a toy. Deals {atk} damage and makes a very undignified BONK noise.

bottle_launcher.name: Bottle Launcher
bottle_launcher.desc: A pressurised milk-bottle that fires itself as a projectile. Deals {atk} damage and splashes warm milk everywhere on impact.

nursery_rattle.name: Jumbo Nursery Rattle
nursery_rattle.desc: A rattle the size of your head. Every swing makes a sound louder than a thunderclap. Deals {atk} damage.

knitting_needle_weapon.name: Repurposed Knitting Needle
knitting_needle_weapon.desc: A long steel needle recovered from a decommissioned NannyBot crafting unit. Surprisingly effective. Deals {atk} damage.

formula_wand.name: Formula Dispenser Wand
formula_wand.desc: A stolen wand attachment from a Formula Feeder Bot. Fires warming formula at enemies, confusing them. ATK 4. Hits in both DEF and WET categories.

safety_helmet.name: Padded Safety Helmet
safety_helmet.desc: A thick foam helmet that the nursery requires all residents to wear. Embarrassing, but DEF +3.

sensor_cap.name: Bladder Sensor Cap
sensor_cap.desc: A monitoring cap that detects bladder pressure and broadcasts it over the local NannyBot network. DEF +0. Wet meter ticks 20% faster while worn. Deeply humiliating.

auto_tutu.name: Auto-Fitted Tutu
auto_tutu.desc: A bright pink tutu that snapped around your waist automatically when you walked past a robot. The layers of tulle make your diaper situation extremely obvious. DEF +1.

nursery_coverall.name: Nursery Coverall
nursery_coverall.desc: A snap-crotch coverall in pastel yellow. The snaps between the legs mean it has to come off completely for anything. DEF +2.

locking_bib.name: Locking Feeder Bib
locking_bib.desc: A heavy-duty bib with a magnetic clasp the NannyBots use for feeding. It clips around the neck and covers the front. Drool-resistant. DEF +1.

potty_pants.name: Training Pants (Electronic)
potty_pants.desc: Soft training pants with embedded moisture sensors. Every time the sensors detect an accident, they play a cheerful little JINGLE at full volume. DEF +1.

lockable_bloomers.name: Locked Nursery Bloomers
lockable_bloomers.desc: Thick pastel bloomers with a small padlock at the waistband. Covers the diaper fully - not that it helps much with dignity. Cannot be removed. DEF +1.

auto_diaper.name: Auto-Taped Nursery Diaper
auto_diaper.desc: A thick mechanical diaper fired from a Diaper Dispenser Bot. The adhesive tabs deployed automatically and are bonded to your skin. Cannot be removed. ATK -2, DEX -3.

max_absorbency_diaper.name: Maximum Absorbency Diaper
max_absorbency_diaper.desc: An industrial nursery diaper rated for 24-hour continuous capacity. It is enormous. The packaging says 'For VERY small adventurers'. ATK -3, DEX -4.

diaper_school_issued.name: School-Issued Diaper
diaper_school_issued.desc: A thick institutional diaper. Your name has been written on the waistband in permanent marker. It feels like a declaration. It is not coming off without help. ATK -1, DEX -2.

nursery_nappy.name: Disposable Nursery Nappy
nursery_nappy.desc: A thin flat disposable nappy printed with little ducks wearing tiny hats. Minimal protection, maximum childishness. ATK -1, DEX -1.

white_diaper.name: Institutional White Diaper
white_diaper.desc: Plain white. No patterns, no prints. Just the standard intake-issue protection pressed into your hands at registration, folded with clinical efficiency and absolutely no ceremony. ATK -1, DEX -1.

activity_socks.name: Activity Socks (Jingles)
activity_socks.desc: White ankle socks with tiny jingle bells sewn around the cuff. Every step announces your presence. Adorable. Mortifying. DEF +1.

nursery_booties.name: Padded Nursery Booties
nursery_booties.desc: Thick foam booties that make no noise when you walk. The treads say 'BABY STEPS'. Snapped on by a NannyBot. DEF +2.

formula_bottle_an.name: Auto-Nursery Formula
formula_bottle_an.desc: Warm enriched baby formula in a big bottle with a soft nipple top. Restores 18 HP but the nutrients... do things. Wet meter +15 after digestion.

gummy_vitamins.name: Gummy Vitamins
gummy_vitamins.desc: Brightly coloured bear-shaped supplements from the nursery dispensary. Restores 8 HP. The fine print says 'may cause unpredictable gastric events'.

lullaby_syrup.name: Lullaby Syrup
lullaby_syrup.desc: A purple sleepy-time syrup the NannyBots dispense at bedtime. Restores 25 HP but causes an immediate bladder relaxation event. Wet meter +30.

nanny_juice_box.name: Nanny's Juice Box
nanny_juice_box.desc: A tiny juice box with a foil straw. Extremely sugary. Restores 12 HP and Tum +25 from all the sugar. You shouldn't have had three.

printed_diaper_auto.name: Printed Disposable (Rocket Ships)
printed_diaper_auto.desc: A cute printed disposable from the nursery supply closet. Covered in rocket ships and stars. 'TO INFINITY AND BEYOND!' on the waistband. ATK -1, DEX -2.

utopia_smart_diaper.name: Utopia Smart Diaper
utopia_smart_diaper.desc: Rune-woven padding dispensed by Utopia's Auto-Changing Stations. A soft glow along the waistband tells everyone how you're doing, which in Utopia is considered polite. INT +1, DEX -1.

all_in_one_1.name: All In One #1
all_in_one_1.desc: A stylish all in one #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

all_in_one_2.name: All In One #2
all_in_one_2.desc: A stylish all in one #2. Fills both torso and pants slots.

baby_one_piece_1.name: Baby One Piece #1
baby_one_piece_1.desc: A stylish baby one piece #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

babydoll_top_1.name: Babydoll Top #1
babydoll_top_1.desc: A stylish babydoll top #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

cat_bodysuit_1.name: Cat Bodysuit #1
cat_bodysuit_1.desc: A stylish cat bodysuit #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

denim_shorttalls_1.name: Denim Shorttalls #1
denim_shorttalls_1.desc: A stylish denim shorttalls #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

diaper_cover_all_1.name: Diaper Cover All #1
diaper_cover_all_1.desc: A stylish diaper cover all #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

ducky_romper_1.name: Ducky Romper #1
ducky_romper_1.desc: A stylish ducky romper #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

frilly_dress_1.name: Frilly Dress #1
frilly_dress_1.desc: A stylish frilly dress #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

magical_effects.popup_text: {item} suddenly cinches tight around your legs. You can't move!
magical_effects.log_text: {item} tightens and traps you in place.
magical_effects.lock_text: You wrestle with {item}, trying to free your legs...

hello_kitty_dress_1.name: Hello Kitty Dress #1
hello_kitty_dress_1.desc: A stylish hello kitty dress #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

holey_all_in_one_1.name: Holey All In One #1
holey_all_in_one_1.desc: A stylish holey all in one #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

latex_apron_1.name: Latex Apron #1
latex_apron_1.desc: A stylish latex apron #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

latex_playsuit_1.name: Latex Playsuit #1
latex_playsuit_1.desc: A stylish latex playsuit #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

loli_dress_1.name: Loli Dress #1
loli_dress_1.desc: A stylish loli dress #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

mummys_pumpkin_t_shirt_1.name: Mummys Pumpkin T Shirt #1
mummys_pumpkin_t_shirt_1.desc: A stylish mummys pumpkin t shirt #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

net_body_suit_1.name: Net Body Suit #1
net_body_suit_1.desc: A stylish net body suit #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

pinafore_1.name: Pinafore #1
pinafore_1.desc: A stylish pinafore #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

pink_rubber_top_1.name: Pink Rubber Top #1
pink_rubber_top_1.desc: A stylish pink rubber top #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

pink_shorttalls_1.name: Pink Shorttalls #1
pink_shorttalls_1.desc: A stylish pink shorttalls #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

pink_tutu_dress_1.name: Pink Tutu Dress #1
pink_tutu_dress_1.desc: A stylish pink tutu dress #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

pumpkin_dress_1.name: Pumpkin Dress #1
pumpkin_dress_1.desc: A stylish pumpkin dress #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

romantic_dress_1.name: Romantic Dress #1
romantic_dress_1.desc: A stylish romantic dress #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

romper_2.name: Romper #2
romper_2.desc: A stylish romper #2. Fills both torso and pants slots.

magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

patient_file.name: Patient File
patient_file.desc: A classified patient file documenting regression experiments. Contains damning evidence of Chrysalis Corporation's true activities.

admission_form.name: Forged Admission Form
admission_form.desc: A falsified admission form with your name on it. Proof that your 'voluntary' admission to the hospital was fabricated.

remedy_herb.name: Remedy Herb
remedy_herb.desc: A pungent bundle of forest herbs used to brew a soothing stomach remedy.

moonbloom_herb.name: Moonbloom Herb
moonbloom_herb.desc: A rare silver-blue herb that opens under moonlight. Fern needs it for restorative remedies.

goblin_forge_fragment.name: Goblin Forge Fragment
goblin_forge_fragment.desc: A jagged chunk of enchanted forge metal scavenged from goblin gearwork.

aged_cask.name: Aged Cask
aged_cask.desc: A heavy oak cask of well-aged ale, somehow still intact after years underground.

sole_mechanism.name: Sole Mechanism
sole_mechanism.desc: A precision spring-and-gear assembly meant for advanced self-adjusting footwear.

merchants_crate.name: Merchant's Crate
merchants_crate.desc: A sealed trade crate stamped with Vera's route mark and reinforced for rough travel.

basils_letter.name: Basil's Letter
basils_letter.desc: A carefully folded letter from Basil, meant to be delivered to Nell in Observation.

village_census.name: Village Census
village_census.desc: Elder Rowan's completed census scroll for the Community Hall cartography archive.

master_blade.name: Master Blade
master_blade.desc: A weapon forged from a genuine Goblin Forge Fragment. Grog's finest work. ATK 14.

mechanized_shoes.name: Mechanized Shoes
mechanized_shoes.desc: Finely-crafted shoes by Patches, fitted with a self-adjusting Sole Mechanism. +2 DEF, +1 DEX.

silkas_masterwork.name: Silka's Masterwork
silkas_masterwork.desc: Silka's finest creation — an elaborate, exquisitely-made dress. Childish score 9. +1 DEF.

premium_protection.name: Premium Protection
premium_protection.desc: Prudence's top-shelf absorbent protection — well-fitted and discreet. Childish score 8.

exam_gloves.name: Disposable Exam Gloves
exam_gloves.desc: Blue nitrile examination gloves. Snap them on for that clinical feel. +1 ATK from the intimidation factor. Sterile magic sometimes guides your hands.

popup_lines: {item} snap tight with sterile magic, guiding {name}'s hands into careful motion.
A brisk enchantment in {item} corrects {name}'s posture.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

bib_1.name: Baby Bib
bib_1.desc: A plain white baby bib with a snap closure. 'My First Bib' embroidered in pastel thread. Utterly infantilizing.

lace_bib_1.name: Lace Bib
lace_bib_1.desc: A delicate bib trimmed with elaborate lace. Somehow makes wearing a bib even more humiliating. The lace charm fusses over imaginary spills.

popup_lines: {item} flutters up and catches an imaginary spill with smug precision.
The lace on {item} wriggles like it expects {name} to make a mess.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

plastic_bib_1.name: Plastic Bib
plastic_bib_1.desc: A crinkly, wipe-clean plastic bib. Very practical. Very degrading. The snaps are hard to undo yourself. Its glossy plastic can crinkle magically.

popup_lines: {item} crinkles loudly, far louder than it has any right to.
A glossy shimmer rolls over {item}, announcing {name}'s every move.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

scoop_bib_1.name: Scoop Bib
scoop_bib_1.desc: A rigid bib with a built-in food-catching trough at the bottom. For messy eaters — or messy adventurers. The pocket opens when its feeding charm wakes.

popup_lines: {item} scoops itself forward like it is ready for feeding time.
The pocket on {item} opens with a cheerful little pop.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

pumpkin_bib_1.name: Pumpkin Bib (Orange)
pumpkin_bib_1.desc: A festive pumpkin-themed bib in bright orange. Perfect for Halloween — or year-round humiliation.

pumpkin_bib_2.name: Pumpkin Bib (Green)
pumpkin_bib_2.desc: A pumpkin bib variant in mossy green. Looks like something a woodland witch would tie on you.

pumpkin_bib_3.name: Pumpkin Bib (Purple)
pumpkin_bib_3.desc: A dark purple pumpkin bib with spooky stitching. Pairs well with a witch's hex and a wet diaper.

anchor_collar_1.name: Anchor Collar
anchor_collar_1.desc: A heavy nautical collar with a dangling anchor charm. Weighs you down in more ways than one. DEF +1.

popup_lines: The anchor charm crackles: '{name}, posture check! You're blushing again.'
A tiny speaker in {item} chirps: 'Attention! {name} is being extra embarrassing today.'
{item} pings loudly: '{name}, did you forget everyone can hear this?'

collar_chain.name: Chain Collar
collar_chain.desc: A thick chain-link collar. Industrial and unmistakable. Makes you feel owned. DEF +2. The chain can tug with invisible force.

popup_lines: {item} gives a sudden magical tug, stopping {name} mid-step.
The chain on {item} pulls taut as if hooked by invisible fingers.
magical_effects.log_text: {item} yanks you short. Movement locked until you break free!
magical_effects.lock_text: The chain on {item} pulls tight while {name} struggles to get moving again...

collar_heart.name: Heart Collar
collar_heart.desc: A collar with a dangling heart-shaped tag. Cute and possessive. Someone wants you to remember who you belong to.

collar_heart_sparkle.name: Sparkle Heart Collar
collar_heart_sparkle.desc: A glittering collar with a heart charm that catches the light. So pretty you almost forget you're wearing a collar. The heart charm occasionally pings pink light.

popup_lines: {item} flashes a bright pink heart right when {name} tries to look serious.
The charm on {item} twinkles and broadcasts a little lovesick chime.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

collar_hex.name: Hex Collar
collar_hex.desc: A collar etched with arcane hexagonal runes. Pulses with faint magic. Wet resist -1. Its runes sometimes leak damp hex-magic.

popup_lines: The runes on {item} crawl into a warning pattern.
{item} pulses with a damp little hex that settles low in {name}'s belly.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

collar_slave.name: Slave Collar
collar_slave.desc: A thick leather collar with a brass ring. The word 'SLAVE' is embossed in the leather. DEF +1.

collar_spike.name: Spiked Collar
collar_spike.desc: A punk-style collar bristling with metal spikes. Intimidating. ATK +1, DEF +1. The spikes can flare with protective force.

popup_lines: {item} bristles with protective magic.
The spikes on {item} flare, daring the room to try something.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

collar_bbc.name: BBC Collar
collar_bbc.desc: A collar with a brass tag bearing three bold letters. The implications are... considerable.

collar_cock.name: Cock Collar
collar_cock.desc: A collar with a very explicit charm dangling from it. Impossible to explain away in polite company.

collar_cum_slut_1.name: Name Tag Collar
collar_cum_slut_1.desc: A collar with a name tag that reads something deeply embarrassing. You don't want anyone to see it up close.

collar_fuck_doll.name: Doll Collar
collar_fuck_doll.desc: A collar with a tag reading 'DOLL'. The objectification is the point. Shame -20.

collar_wc.name: WC Collar
collar_wc.desc: A collar whose tag reads 'WC' with a toilet symbol. A not-so-subtle reference to your bathroom reliability. Wet resist -1. Its water-drop rune gives very public warnings.

popup_lines: {item} chirps: 'Bathroom break recommended for {name}!'
A little water-drop rune blinks on {item}.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

steel_collar_1.name: Steel Collar
steel_collar_1.desc: A polished steel collar that locks with a click. Cold, heavy, and impossible to forget. DEF +2. Its steel band can lock your posture in place.

popup_lines: {item} stiffens and forces {name} to stand still for inspection.
The steel band grows heavy, pinning {name} in place for a breath.
magical_effects.log_text: {item} locks your posture. Movement locked until you break free!
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} holds {name} rigid while the enchantment judges her posture...

lipstick_collar_1.name: Lipstick Collar
lipstick_collar_1.desc: A sleek collar with a glossy lipstick-red finish. Glamorous submission.

pullstring_collar_1.name: Pull-String Collar
pullstring_collar_1.desc: A collar with a pull-string on the back. When someone tugs it, you say pre-recorded phrases. 'I need my diaper changed!'

popup_lines: Your pullstring on your collar gets caught, and you brace yourself for another embarassing line: "I wet myself!" you proclaim loudly, unable to control yourself
Your pullstring on your collar gets caught, and you brace yourself for another embarassing line: "My Panties are Messy!" you proclaim loudly, unable to control yourself
Your pullstring on your collar gets caught, and you brace yourself for another embarassing line: "My diaper sure does need a change~!" you proclaim loudly, unable to control yourself
magical_effects.lock_text: You struggle against {item}...

pink_rubber_dress_collar_1.name: Pink Rubber Collar
pink_rubber_dress_collar_1.desc: A glossy pink rubber collar with an attached dress bib. Squeaky, shiny, and deeply embarrassing. DEF +1.

cat_bell_1.name: Cat Bell
cat_bell_1.desc: A tiny golden bell on a ribbon. Jingles with every step. Now everyone knows exactly where you are. DEX -1. The bell sometimes jingles with playful magic.

popup_lines: {item} jingles with a playful little mew.
A magical jingle from {item} makes {name}'s steps feel bouncy and silly.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

cow_bell_1.name: Cow Bell
cow_bell_1.desc: A heavy brass cowbell on a leather strap. CLONK CLONK CLONK. Zero stealth. DEX -2, DEF +1. The heavy bell occasionally clonks on its own.

popup_lines: {item} clonks loudly enough to make {name} wince.
A heavy farmyard chime rolls out of {item}.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

meow_cow_bell_1.name: Meow Cow Bell
meow_cow_bell_1.desc: A bell that somehow makes a 'meow' sound instead of ringing. Adorable and baffling. Childish +7. Its confused charm meows and moos at random.

popup_lines: {item} cannot decide whether to meow or moo, so it does both.
The bell on {item} lets out a confused magical chorus.
magical_effects.log_text: {item} makes a ridiculous noise: excitement +4, wet +2.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

necklace_1.name: Silver Necklace
necklace_1.desc: A simple silver chain necklace. Elegant but unassuming. DEF +1.

necklace_2.name: Pearl Necklace
necklace_2.desc: A strand of luminous pearls. Sophisticated and dignified — a rare feeling in this world. DEF +1.

necklace_3.name: Ruby Pendant
necklace_3.desc: A necklace with a deep red gemstone. Warm to the touch. HP regen +1. The ruby can pulse with restorative warmth.

popup_lines: {item} beats once with warm red light.
A ruby pulse from {item} sends courage through {name}'s chest.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

necklace_4.name: Amber Necklace
necklace_4.desc: A necklace with a chunk of fossilized amber. Something ancient stirs inside. Wet resist +1.

necklace_5.name: Star Pendant
necklace_5.desc: A necklace with a tiny star charm. Makes you feel like a magical girl — for better or worse. The star charm may force a dramatic sparkle pose.

popup_lines: {item} flashes and nudges {name} into a dramatic magical-girl pose.
A tiny starburst from {item} makes the room feel briefly staged.
magical_effects.log_text: {item} forces a sparkle pose: excitement +5, stamina -2.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

necklace_6.name: Moon Pendant
necklace_6.desc: A crescent moon pendant that glows faintly in the dark. Tum resist +1. Moonlit magic sometimes raises a sleepy tide.

popup_lines: {item} glows with a sleepy blue tide.
Moonlit magic from {item} makes {name}'s belly flutter.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

mystical_amulet_1.name: Mystical Amulet
mystical_amulet_1.desc: An ancient amulet thrumming with unknown power. Wet resist +2, DEF +1. Its magic feels... maternal. Its maternal ward can wake at inconvenient times.

popup_lines: {item} glows with protective, embarrassingly gentle magic.
A soft ward from {item} steadies {name} like a hand at her back.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

soulstone_1.name: Soulstone Pendant
soulstone_1.desc: A necklace holding a swirling violet soulstone. Whispers forgotten lullabies. HP regen +2, Childish +4. The soulstone sometimes gives back a little strength.

popup_lines: {item} drinks in the room's pressure and gives a little warmth back.
A violet glow in {item} steadies {name}'s pulse.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

necktie_1.name: Striped Necktie
necktie_1.desc: A professional striped necktie. Makes you look serious and grown-up. Childish -2.

necktie_2.name: Polka Dot Necktie
necktie_2.desc: A colourful polka-dot necktie. Cheerful but slightly juvenile. At least you're dressed up.

scarf_1.name: Cozy Scarf
scarf_1.desc: A thick, warm scarf in autumnal colours. Comforting and practical. DEF +1. Cozy yarn magic can wrap you in warmth.

popup_lines: {item} snuggles closer, warm as a blanket.
Soft yarn magic from {item} helps {name} breathe easier.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

scarf_2.name: Silk Scarf
scarf_2.desc: A lightweight silk scarf with an elegant drape. Sophisticated camouflage for your rather less sophisticated undergarments.

vampire_cape_1.name: Vampire Cape (Red)
vampire_cape_1.desc: A dramatic red-lined vampire cape. Sweeps behind you as you walk. Conceals panties! DEF +2. Crimson stage magic sometimes billows around you.

popup_lines: {item} billows dramatically, hiding {name} for one theatrical second.
A crimson flourish from {item} turns embarrassment into stagecraft.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

vampire_cape_2.name: Vampire Cape (Purple)
vampire_cape_2.desc: A purple-lined vampire cape. Equally dramatic, slightly more regal. Conceals panties! DEF +2. Its purple glamour can briefly steady your nerves.

popup_lines: {item} casts a dusky glamour over {name}'s outline.
Purple shadow rolls from {item}, making {name} feel briefly untouchable.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

accessories_apron.name: Frilly Apron
accessories_apron.desc: A cute frilly kitchen apron. Makes you look like a very little helper. Conceals panties from the front. DEF +1.

stethoscope_1.name: Stethoscope
stethoscope_1.desc: A proper medical stethoscope. Wearing this makes you look like a doctor, not a patient. Childish -3. DEF +1.

stethoscope_2.name: Toy Stethoscope
stethoscope_2.desc: A plastic toy stethoscope in bright pink. You're playing doctor! ...or are you the patient? The toy checkup charm beeps when it feels neglected.

popup_lines: {item} squeaks and announces: 'Checkup time for {name}!'
The toy diaphragm on {item} beeps out a nursery rhythm.
magical_effects.log_text: {item} performs a toy checkup: wet +4, HP +4.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

combat_visor_1.name: Combat-Doll Visor
combat_visor_1.desc: A high-tech combat visor with a heads-up display. ATK +2, DEX +1. Finally, something that makes you look cool.

popup_lines: You feel something in the back of your mind dimming, as your subconscious mind interprets the instructions flawlessly.
Thousands of images flash in front of your eyes, too fast for your subconscious mind to interpret.
magical_effects.lock_text: You struggle against {item}...

tartan_bra_earrings_1.name: Tartan Earrings
tartan_bra_earrings_1.desc: Dangly tartan-patterned earrings. Scottish chic meets dungeon fashion.

ball_gag_1.name: Ball Gag (Red)
ball_gag_1.desc: A classic red ball gag strapped tightly in place. Muffles speech completely. DEF +1. Shame -15.

ball_gag_2.name: Ball Gag (Pink)
ball_gag_2.desc: A pink ball gag with a heart-shaped buckle. Somehow cuter and more humiliating than the red one.

ball_gag_3.name: Ball Gag (Black)
ball_gag_3.desc: A matte black ball gag. Industrial and severe. DEF +2. Shame -12.

bit_gag_1.name: Bit Gag
bit_gag_1.desc: A metal bit gag usually reserved for ponygirls. You can still drool freely. How dignified.

bone_gag_1.name: Bone Gag
bone_gag_1.desc: A gag shaped like a dog bone. For the pet who misbehaves. Woof.

dental_gag_1.name: Dental Gag
dental_gag_1.desc: A stainless steel dental retractor that forces your mouth open. Clinical, uncomfortable, deeply unsexy. DEF +1.

duck_gag_1.name: Duck Gag
duck_gag_1.desc: A gag shaped like a rubber duck bill. Quack quack. You look ridiculous. Childish +8.

facehugger_1.name: Facehugger Gag
facehugger_1.desc: A horrifying alien-inspired gag that wraps around your entire face. Nobody wants to look at you. DEF +2.

lips_gag_1.name: Lips Gag
lips_gag_1.desc: A gag with exaggerated inflatable lips on the outside. Makes you look like a cartoon character. Childish +5.

portal_gag_1.name: Portal Gag
portal_gag_1.desc: A ring gag with a glowing portal inside it. Where does it lead? Best not to think about it. DEF +1.

ring_gag_1.name: Ring Gag
ring_gag_1.desc: A simple metal ring gag. Keeps your mouth open. The drool is inevitable.

pacifier_1.name: Pink Pacifier
pacifier_1.desc: A large adult-sized pacifier in bubblegum pink. Soothing but humiliating. HP regen +1. Childish +9.

pacifier_2.name: Blue Pacifier
pacifier_2.desc: An oversized baby-blue pacifier. The rhythmic sucking is... disturbingly calming. HP regen +1.

pacifier_3.name: Green Pacifier
pacifier_3.desc: A mint-green pacifier with a leaf motif. Forest-themed infantilization. HP regen +1.

pacifier_4.name: Purple Pacifier
pacifier_4.desc: A royal purple pacifier. Even the colour scheme can't make this dignified. HP regen +1.

pumpkin_paci_1.name: Pumpkin Pacifier
pumpkin_paci_1.desc: A pacifier shaped like a tiny pumpkin. Seasonal shame. HP regen +1. Childish +10.

spider_paci_1.name: Spider Pacifier
spider_paci_1.desc: A pacifier with a spiderweb pattern and tiny spider charm. Creepy AND infantilizing. HP regen +1.

small_paci_gag_1.name: Pacifier Gag
small_paci_gag_1.desc: A pacifier with a strap that buckles behind the head. Can't spit it out. HP regen +2 but Cursed!

cock_paci_1.name: Adult Pacifier (Variant A)
cock_paci_1.desc: An adult-shaped pacifier. The shape is... suggestive. Deeply embarrassing. HP regen +1.

cock_paci_2.name: Adult Pacifier (Variant B)
cock_paci_2.desc: Another adult-shaped pacifier, this one even more explicit. The humiliation is the point. HP regen +1.

medical_wristband_2.name: Patient Wristband (Blue)
medical_wristband_2.desc: A tighter-fitting hospital wristband in pale blue. The text reads INCONTINENCE WARD - MONITORING REQUIRED in bold capitals.

medical_wristband_3.name: Patient Wristband (Pink)
medical_wristband_3.desc: A hospital wristband in soft pink with a tiny diaper icon next to the barcode. The fine print lists your scheduled diaper checks.

dq_clothing_waddle_diaper2_large.name: Waddle Diaper2 Large
dq_clothing_waddle_diaper2_large.desc: A pair of waddle diaper2 large.

dq_clothing_waddle_diaper3_large.name: Waddle Diaper3 Large
dq_clothing_waddle_diaper3_large.desc: A pair of waddle diaper3 large.
